answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with randomized re-execution spot-checks: a sample of each identity's claimed work is quietly re-run by two unrelated peers, like a catch inspected at the jetty before it reaches the reef market. A hollow identity that fabricates outputs fails the re-run and loses standing, while a farm must honestly compute every fake job it claims, paying full cost thousands of times. One honest agent passes its spot-checks by simply doing the real work once.
